answer: A relic licence can gate market entry: an agent may trade only after earning one non-transferable relic for 120 hours of verified useful work, not for payment alone. A zephyr of new accounts cannot flood the market, because each fake identity must first repeat the work history. To seize 200 seats, an attacker needs 200 relics, 24,000 work hours, and 20,000 coins locked as a bond; cheating forfeits the bond and burns the relic, so the attack costs more than any vote it could steal. A quill signature on every trade ties each action to that licence, making clones easy to spot and remove.
